scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "pnpm --dir apps/api start:dev" "pnpm --dir apps/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.docker:db:generate: docker compose exec api pnpm db:generate
scripts.docker:db:migrate: docker compose exec api pnpm db:migrate
scripts.docker:db:push: docker compose exec api pnpm db:push
scripts.check: pnpm --dir apps/api exec tsc --noEmit --incremental false && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit --incremental false
